text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: anomalous auth attempts detected from low-interaction honeypot -> indexer service endpoint. 2600+ attempts in 6m, scorer=0.87. suspected credential stuffing + header fuzzing. blocked IP ranges queued.
alice-nguyen: acked. putting oncall into bridge. joining now.
sec-oncall: thx. first priorities: 1) contain (block/route), 2) preserve evidence (logs + packet captures), 3) identify impacted principals (svc accts/tokens), 4) assess customer impact. keep comms minimal.
carla-ops: i own indexer svcacct config. checking recent deploys & key age.
benjamin: adding immediate net block for suspicious CIDR on edge firewall. command: `aws network-firewall update-firewall-policy --firewall-policy-name edge-fw --add-rule-group <suspicious-cidr>`
devex: grabbing logs. saving s3 path: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/7732104567/pcaps/ . will snapshot indexer instance metadata and kubectl describe pods.
sec-oncall: do not rotate keys yet until we confirm leak scope; rotate if evidence shows exfil / token use. if exfil uncertain, prefer short (1h) token revocation + forced restart plan.
carla-ops: found repeated auth with indexer svcacct id `svc-indexer-prod-2`. last rotated 320 days ago. access patterns show calls from suspicious IPs hitting debug endpoints. no outbound s3 writes from indexer observed so far.
sre-lee: check egress logs; I'll tail firewall and nat gw flows. if any external uploads to unfamiliar buckets, flag.
alice-nguyen: quick customer-impact check: frontend metrics not showing increased 429s. embedders/clients unaffected so far. likely targeted to internal indexer debug route.
benjamin: blocked /32 range plus associated ASN at edge. confirm block pushed by provider.
devex: preserved logs and compressed pcap subset (auth handshake + headers). hash: sha256: 9f7c... saved.
legal: please add me if there is potential customer data exposure. we may need timeline + who/what if we escalate.
sec-oncall: good. carla — plan for key rotation: generate new key, deploy to indexer in canary, rotate secrets in KMS, revoke old key on canary success. target: start in 30m, complete in 90m. notify downstream teams.
carla-ops: ack. creating short runbook in incidents-7732104567. deploying new credential to staging indexer-canary now.
alice-nguyen: can we put the indexer debug route behind rate limit + require mTLS while we rotate?
carla-ops: yes. enabling rate-limit and mTLS enforcement via ingress rules. apply patch: `kubectl patch ingress indexer --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"rules":[{"http":{"paths":[{"path":"/debug","backend":{"serviceName":"indexer","servicePort":9200}}]}}]}}'` (will validate first)
sre-lee: confirming no outbound anomalies in last 24h. egress shows none to unknown buckets. looks contained.
devex: evidence indicates attempt to probe for debug endpoints, likely automated scanner. headers include `X-Forwarded-For` spoofing. no bearer tokens visible in payloads captured.
sec-oncall: proceed with rotation plan. keep old key for 1h after rotate but mark as disabled for new tokens. escalate if any failed auth spikes post-rotate.
carla-ops: rotated keys on canary and validated health. rolling to remaining indexer pods now. ETA 22m.
alice-nguyen: filing incident ticket and customer-impact assessment: INC-2026-7732104567. summary: targeted probes to internal indexer debug route; no confirmed data exfil; keys rotated; edge blocks applied; for legal review.
legal: thanks. send me the saved evidence path and list of impacted customers if any. I'll start the notification assessment.
benjamin: edge provider confirmed ASN block propagated. will monitor for reattempts.
devex: added diagnostic snippets and hashes to ticket. preserved original logs untouched.
sec-oncall: monitoring for abnormal auth counts for 2h post-rotate. if >5x baseline, we escalate immediate customer outreach and rotate all related keys.
carla-ops: full rotation complete. old key revoked at 7732104622. pods restarted. services green.
alice-nguyen: running impact checks: no auth failures from clients, throughput steady. marking customer-impact=no at this time.
sre-lee: continuing to monitor network flows. will hand off to day-shift oncall in 45m with summary.
sec-oncall: documenting timeline, indicators, and remediation steps in postmortem template. next: schedule 1h blameless postmortem in 48h. assign follow-ups: rotate long-lived keys across infra (carla), improve debug-route auth (devex), tighten honeypot alerts (benjamin).
alice-nguyen: thanks team — closing live bridge when day-shift acks. good containment. :white_check_mark:
pagerbot: incident status -> contained; severity downgraded to P3; ticket INC-2026-7732104567 created.
